task: Repair root_squash compatibility for non-root nfs-csi workloads while retaining root_squash on both exports and mode 0750 on the export root.

events.summary: Reviewed issue #224, repository guidance and existing NFS changes; inspected the bundled CSI chart template and addon StorageClass/PVC behavior.
Reproduced the blocker using Helm 4.2.1: an executable path passed to --post-renderer is rejected because Helm expects a named plugin.
evidence: Error: invalid argument "/tmp/pr.sh" for "--post-renderer" flag: plugin: {Name:/tmp/pr.sh Type:postrenderer/v1} not found

events.summary: Removed the Helm 3 post-renderer and rely on the Helm feature value. Chart 4.13.2 emits fsGroupPolicy: File only when enabled; disabling omits it. NFS has no fstype and the verification PVC uses ReadWriteMany, so the Kubernetes default does not trigger fsGroup ownership changes. For existing clusters, the pre-upgrade guard deletes the CSIDriver only when its immutable live policy is exactly File, then checks after Helm that File is gone.

Disabled Grafana initChownData in direct Helm and GitOps owners. Swept deployed NFS PVC consumers: Harbor, Gitea, SeaweedFS, OpenBao, CNPG, Prometheus and Alertmanager use server-converged writable PV dirs; Prometheus/Alertmanager, Gitea and OpenBao may set fsGroup, but CSI fsGroupPolicy is off and StorageClass has no fsType, so kubelet ownership changes do not run. SeaweedFS runs as root-squashed UID with PV mode 0777. Harbor uses external PostgreSQL and internal Redis without PVCs; Bitnami PostgreSQL and volumePermissions are disabled. Loki/Tempo persistence and Harbor Trivy are disabled; Velero plugin initContainer uses emptyDir. No other enabled root chown/chmod init container on an NFS PVC was found.

R186 passed for both installation owners; R186b removed the override in a temporary GitOps copy and the check rejected it. ShellCheck --severity=warning passed across scripts/, bash -n passed across scripts/, and regression-check-kakao.sh --static passed (218 passed, 0 failed, 4 warnings).
events.scope: Grafana root chown mitigation, NFS chart permissions sweep, regression suite and trace gates

events.summary: Lead review: Helm 4 rejects executable --post-renderer paths (live: 'plugin ... not found'); replaced by feature.enableFSGroupPolicy=false plus a File-only pre-upgrade CSIDriver delete and a post-check.

events.scope: live six-node kubeadm 1.35 cluster, root_squash NFS on master-1
events.summary: With the per-PV timer installed and the StorageClass without mountPermissions: nfs-nonroot-write-check.sh PASS (uid 26 wrote to an nfs-csi PVC after the timer window, pod Completed, /srv/nfs/k8s stays 750). Grafana with initChownData disabled: 3/3 Running with no init containers (was Init:CrashLoopBackOff on 'chown: /var/lib/grafana: Operation not permitted'). helm --dry-run=server upgrade of csi-driver-nfs with the new values accepted.
evidence: runtime:master-1 nfs-nonroot-write-check.sh => PASS uid 26 wrote; /srv/nfs/k8s remains 750
runtime:kubectl -n monitoring get pods => grafana 3/3 Running, initContainers=[]

events.summary: The Grafana root init-chown failure is covered in both installation owners and guarded by R186/R186b; requested local checks pass. Live Grafana recovery after applying the updated desired state remains a separate runtime confirmation.
